why: pass 4's rows lost J2's identified gap to CAD's clip at 0 (CAD's J2 span is 0.283 deg longer than the twin's), so the no-physics re-score (homing_fivebar_mujoco_pass4_rescore_2026-11-13.json) cannot score J2; this reruns the two press_reverse rows with run_one's twin_note storing the twin-referenced gap
command: mujoco_bench --models <m> --procedures press_reverse press_reverse+gff --workers 3 (per model; B1 split in two)
determinism: every CAD-referenced column (outcome, zero error, gap) of every row equals pass 4's to 1e-7 (max abs diff 0.0 deg), so the rerun is pass 4's physics, re-observed
